meta.title: SVG to PNG Converter - S-Jiffy
meta.description: Convert SVG vector graphics to PNG raster images. Set custom scale and size.
formatAutoDetected: Format is auto-detected — no need to select manually
anyFormatDesc: Drop a PNG, JPG, WebP, SVG, AVIF, or HEIC image and convert it to any supported output. You don't need to match the current page.
tooManyConversions: Too many conversions. Please wait a moment.
steps_svg-to-png_1Desc: Select an SVG vector graphic. Converting to PNG rasterizes the vector paths into a pixel image at your chosen resolution.
steps_svg-to-png_2Desc: Choose the width and height for the PNG output. Larger dimensions give more detail but produce bigger files. The aspect ratio is preserved from the SVG.
steps_svg-to-png_3Desc: Click Convert to render your SVG as a PNG at the specified size. Perfect for sharing icons, logos, and illustrations as standard image files.
